subtitulo: ¿Quién está escribiendo su leyenda en la máxima competición?

items.descripcion: Dominant attacking flair, lethal set‑pieces, and a rock‑solid defense drive them to the top.
Swinging creativity and superstar talent keep Brazil flying high with five‑star attacking football.
Possesion mastery and quick transitions let Spain dominate, netting ten goals while shielding their cage.
Youthful vigor and firepower propel France forward, scoring nine while exposing defensive lapses.
Direct power and clinical finishing give England momentum, converting eight goals despite occasional defensive cracks.
Determined resilience and fast counterattacks lift USA, scoring seven goals with solid defensive organization.
Surging confidence and skillful winger play boost Canada, netting six goals but struggling at the back.
Heart and flair drive Mexico, yet defensive fragility costs them, conceding 12 goals in close matches.

dato_extra: Argentina lidera con 12 goles, promediando 2.4 por partido, el promedio más alto en la historia del torneo.
